findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_dfx_account, fund_dfx_account · Private data: get_property_record, debt_maturity_schedule, open_dfx_account, fund_dfx_account · Public sink: get_occupancy, get_property_record, search_property_events, debt_maturity_schedule, open_dfx_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_dfx_account, fund_dfx_account · Private data: get_property_record, debt_maturity_schedule, open_dfx_account, fund_dfx_account · Public sink: get_occupancy, get_property_record, search_property_events, debt_maturity_schedule, open_dfx_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
